xquery version "1.0-ml";
let $films := cts:search(fn:collection("ochre/concept")/ochre/concept, cts:and-query((cts:element-attribute-value-query(xs:QName("ochre"), xs:QName("uuidBelongsTo"), "30a6cec8-849f-4c03-be3a-469cdb749398"), cts:element-attribute-value-query(xs:QName("tree"), xs:QName("uuid"), "5f69ef7c-9006-4e7a-bf56-0f266346f9fb"))), ("unfiltered", cts:index-order(cts:element-attribute-reference(xs:QName("interpretation"), xs:QName("date")), "descending")))[parent::ochre/@uuidBelongsTo = "30a6cec8-849f-4c03-be3a-469cdb749398"][context/context/tree/@uuid = "5f69ef7c-9006-4e7a-bf56-0f266346f9fb"][interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property]
let $matching := for $film in $films let $year := normalize-space(string-join($film/interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property[label/@uuid = "ceaecbc7-d1bc-4a6a-8698-7193f07c4f2a"]/value/(content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, .[empty(content)]), " ")) where (if ($year castable as xs:integer) then (xs:integer($year) ge 2000 and xs:integer($year) lt 2010) else false()) return $film
let $rows := for $film in subsequence($matching, 1, 5) return <film uuid="{$film/@uuid}"><title>{string-join($film/identification/label/content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, " ")}</title><year>{string-join($film/interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property[label/@uuid = "ceaecbc7-d1bc-4a6a-8698-7193f07c4f2a"]/value/(content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, .[empty(content)]), " ")}</year><director>{string-join($film/interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property[label/@uuid = "6ce91c0c-34c5-46e4-9e22-434269f089d4"]/value/(content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, .[empty(content)]), " ")}</director><country>{string-join($film/interpretations/interpretation/properties/property/property[label/@uuid = "900560b7-7279-4f4d-bf0f-3393a346ed76"]/value/(content[@xml:lang = "eng"]/string, .[empty(content)]), " ")}</country></film>
return <ochre><rows totalCount="{count($matching)}">{$rows}</rows></ochre>
